snippet.title: Lime Stenched Dirt [Release Trailer]
snippet.description:
Welcome to the Darkened Lands:
Lime Stenched Dirt is a short RPG Maker 2003 game.

In the game you control a girl called Lyza and have to reach a super computer, that is infected by a virus, to safe the Darkened Lands. 

Make friends, battle ghosts and learn more about the history of this ruined world.

The game is about 2-3 hours long and features 3 party members and 2 endings.

All artwork, sprites, music etc. made by Flesh Smoothie.

Get the game here for free:
https://fleshsmoothie.itch.io/lime-stenched-dirt
